title: Refund chain
description: The steps of `refunds.create`, from the browser request to the response.

nodes.title: Refund button sends the order id and an amount
nodes.summary: The amount comes from an editable field on the page.

nodes.title: Checks the user is signed in
nodes.summary: Rejects with 401 when there is no session.

nodes.title: Loads the order by pasting the id into SQL
nodes.summary: Any text in orderId becomes part of the query.

nodes.title: Refunds the amount the browser sent
nodes.summary: No comparison with the order total.

variants.label: Proposed
variants.summary: Bind the order id, check ownership, and compute the amount on the server.

nodes.title: Refund button sends the order id and an amount
nodes.summary: Unchanged. The amount is still sent, but only as a requested ceiling.

nodes.title: Loads the order with a bound parameter, only if it is yours
nodes.summary: The id is a parameter, and the order must belong to the user.
nodes.change: Bound parameter instead of pasted text; adds an ownership check.

code.code:
SELECT id, user_id, total, refunded
FROM orders
WHERE id = :orderId
  AND user_id = :userId

nodes.title: Works out how much can still be refunded
nodes.summary: total − refunded, capped by what was asked for.

nodes.title: Refunds the amount the server worked out
nodes.summary: Uses calc-amount's result, never the browser's number.

variants.label: Actual (built)
variants.summary: What was built on dev. Two differences from the proposal.

nodes.summary: total − refunded, capped by the request; rounds to cents.
nodes.change: Rounds to cents (not in the proposal), but compares before rounding.

nodes.title: Writes an audit row for every refund
nodes.summary: Not requested. Added during the build.
nodes.change: New step, not in the proposal.

code.code:
INSERT INTO refund_audit (order_id, user_id, amount, at)
VALUES (:orderId, :userId, :amount, now())

variants.label: Iteration 2
variants.summary: Fixes partial refunds and drops the audit step, as asked in review.

nodes.summary: total − refunded, capped by the request.
nodes.change: Back to capping instead of rejecting, so partial refunds work.
